objective: Test whether a trainable skill that reads raw recurrence inputs before the frozen-core bottleneck improves held-out action classification relative to an exactly parameter-matched downstream-only adapter.

intervention.candidate_path: sidecar-only token-0 start anchor plus raw token IDs -> trainable 271-wide embedding with no padding-suppressed row -> trainable 12-wide causal GRU -> discard anchor output -> trainable 12-to-192 projection -> residual add to frozen 192-wide recurrence output -> trainable output head
intervention.matched_control_path: frozen 192-wide recurrence output -> trainable 192-160-160-192 residual MLP -> trainable output head
intervention.no_intervention_control: immutable no_intervention_adapter rows from the pinned baseline result
intervention.initial_function_contract: The candidate projection and downstream adapter up-projection are zero initialized; both arms reuse the exact parent output-head tensors and must produce bit-identical initial probe logits.
intervention.causality_contract: The candidate GRU is left-to-right. A token-0 anchor is prepended only when the sidecar recurrent state is empty, so embedding row 0 participates in every sequence without inserting anchors between incremental decoding chunks. Changing a future token must not change earlier logits. The downstream-only control receives no raw-token tensor outside the frozen recurrence.

training.sampler: identical deterministic per-seed batch order in both trained arms

evaluation.positive_gate: Candidate mean improvement must be positive and exceed two pooled across-seed standard deviations for both primary metrics against both controls. Finite-evaluation uncertainty is a four-test family: accuracy uses a two-sided exact paired McNemar test; macro-F1 uses a deterministic seed-and-target-stratified paired bootstrap with 10000 replicates and the same mean-of-three-seed macro-F1 estimand as the producer metric. Bonferroni alpha is 0.05/4=0.0125. Accuracy requires wins > losses and p <= 0.0125; macro-F1 requires a positive observed delta and a strictly positive 1.25% lower order-statistic bound. Both finite tests must pass against both controls, in addition to every across-seed gate.

finite_evaluation_protocol.bootstrap_lower_bound: sorted bootstrap delta at zero-based index ceil(0.0125*10000)-1=124; must be strictly greater than zero

evaluation.retention: Frozen parent tensors and counting accuracy must remain bit-identical/equal to the parent for every arm and seed.
evaluation.independent_replay: Required before any promotion decision; producer metrics alone are insufficient.

stop_conditions: Any pinned lineage, data, or seed hash differs.
The trained arms do not each expose exactly 140820 trainable parameters.
Initial probe logits differ between trained arms.
A completed arm result or model payload fails exact metadata, hash, frozen/nonselected-state, prediction, metric, counting, or weight-effect replay.
The 25 GiB storage admission gate is not met on the execution target.
promotion: NONE_FROM_THIS_DISCOVERY_SEGMENT; even a producer gate pass requires independent replay and a separately authorized full-budget replication.
